title: Daun di Jok Motor
subject: an accountant in Jakarta whose odd private hobby is tracing the outline of whichever leaf has landed on his motorbike seat each morning into a notebook, dated, four hundred pages so far, until one morning there is a leaf from a tree that does not grow on his street
caption: Indonesian 80s pop kreatif revival, jazzy late-80s Jakarta pop in the Wijaya 80 vein. Rhodes electric piano with major-seventh voicings, singing fretless bass slides, clean chorus guitar arpeggios, soft analog brass synth swells, light live drums with rimshot backbeat. Polished late-80s studio sheen with gentle plate reverb. Warm smooth male baritone-to-mid vocal, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, F major. Mood of a quiet curious morning. No trap beats, no autotune, no EDM, no modern bedroom-pop lo-fi crackle, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords, fretless bass]
[Verse 1]
Setiap pagi di parkiran
Satu daun di jok motorku
Kugaris tepinya pelan-pelan
Di buku kecil berwarna biru
[Pre-Chorus]
Ketapang, mangga, kersen tetangga
Semua kukenal bentuknya
[Chorus]
Empat ratus halaman
Empat ratus pagi yang sama
Tapi hari ini ada daun
Yang tak tumbuh di jalan kita
[Verse 2]
Daunnya kecil, bergerigi
Seperti dibawa dari jauh
Kusimpan di saku kemeja
Kantorku bisa menunggu
[Chorus]
Empat ratus halaman
Empat ratus pagi yang sama
Hari ini aku ikuti angin
Mencari pohon yang mengirimnya
[Outro - brass synth swell, Rhodes fade]
Halaman empat ratus satu
Masih kosong, menunggu
